g.text: GCCGGC 4mC undergoes geographic redistribution during development
T1: 83% core → T2: 82% arm → T3: residual (n=21)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #7e57c2

g.text: 62 of 1,055 regulatory genes lack methylation protection at TSS

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #37474f

g.text: The 62 exposed regulators form two antagonistic blocs
Activation (n=35): TCS, Sigma, WhiB — development ON
Repression (n=26): TetR, metabolic regulators — vegetative OFF
Both blocs switch simultaneously at T1→T2 (MW p = 0.459)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #e65100

g.text: Methylation timing is decoupled from expression timing

g.text: This study characterizes methylation distribution and motif patterns;

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #37474f

g.text: a causal role for methylation in gene expression regulation remains to be established.
